subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should cron jobs pinned to an agent be deleted by the canonical `agents delete` lifecycle, with Claw removal composing that lifecycle, or remain a Claw-only ownership contract?
rationale: The branch intentionally preserves ordinary agent deletion while introducing agent-pinned recurring work; choosing the permanent deletion owner changes the generic agent lifecycle and cannot be settled by a mechanical patch alone.

options.title: Make agent deletion canonical
options.body: Have `agents delete` durably remove agent-owned scheduler jobs, then let Claw removal compose that canonical path plus Claw provenance cleanup.

options.title: Keep Claw-only ownership
options.body: Retain the current split only with an explicit product contract that prevents ordinary deletion of agents carrying Claw-owned cron jobs and explains recovery.

recommendation.title: Make agent deletion canonical
recommendation.body: Have `agents delete` durably remove agent-owned scheduler jobs, then let Claw removal compose that canonical path plus Claw provenance cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review identified the exact lifecycle boundary and they are assigned on the PR.
